title: Game and Feel Trailer built with Claude Code
author: CreativeProblem7803
selftext:
I wanted to try out how well Claude can do a trailer for my game, he assembled all scenes and gameplay action himself, I just gave him which fights to include.

What do you think, is this a good enough cinematic trailer for a launch, my game is far from ready, this is not promotion, but truely just an ask for feedback on the trailer quality and content.

**Would you be intriegued by the trailer to play the game** (assuming you enjoy rpgs and/or action rpgs in the fantasy setting) **or at least enjoy watching it till the end?**

comments.author: thetinytrex
comments.body: Looks pretty cool. I think the thing I was missing though is a highlight of the UI and systems. It did get a little repetitive after a while of some hero killing some monster. I was wondering what the skills looked like. What classes? What other features are there? I usually don't like trailers with text like "OVER 500+ SKILLS" or whatever, but at least show us the skill trees, gear loadouts, etc. And is there a story or is it just action RPG?

replies.author: CreativeProblem7803
replies.body:
the thing is, the skill system is not fully ready yet, but your right 1-2 screens with a show off the skill system would be cool addition.  
the game is supposed to have a light story and fully english Voice-over, there will also be light-complex quests, which I wanted to focus on, there are already 5 quests in.
